caption:
Think money is the problem? The verse was aiming elsewhere. (1 Timothy 6:9–10 devotional)

“The love of money is a root of all kinds of evil” — not money itself, but the seat it takes. As a servant it gives life; as a master it burns you first. The question isn't how much you have, but who's on the throne.

📌 Save this for your quiet time this week
